blurb: Mile High Fishing Charters offers guided fishing trips on Lake Tahoe targeting Mackinaw, Rainbow, Brown, and Kokanee Salmon. Trips are suitable for all ages and skill levels, including families and beginners. They operate year-round with small-group charters and local guides.

quotes.author: Clark Good
quotes.text: I had an incredible time on the lake with my boys thanks to Mile High. Our guide, Justin, was laid-back, knowledgeable, and had us catching fish almost immediately.

quotes.author: Sean F
quotes.text: My dad and son went out with Captain Justin this weekend and had a great time. They hit their limit, and Justin even gave solid cooking tips.

quotes.author: Megan H
quotes.text: Everyone in our group landed a fish—even my mom who doesn't fish. We'll definitely book with Mile High again.
